notes:
New / edit constellation (CHR-1146; `{id, name, description?, traits?, relationships[{from, type, to, note?}], generated?}`), saved via `set_use_cases` (`constellations`). 820px over `usecases-world`; also opened from a World card in `usecases-detail-world`.

Fields: Name, ID (mono), Description; **Traits**: one native select per dimension with scope Constellations (4-column grid). A stored trait whose dimension is persona-scoped (or unknown) still shows, as its own select labelled "<Dimension> · personas", so saving never drops it (sample: Channel = Letter). **Relationships**: a fieldset of rows, each `role="group"` with an accessible name ("Relationship 3"), three native selects From / Relationship / To (participants = personas + entities; types from the pool), a **Note** field (`note`, optional; placeholder "Note") and a remove button. A row with a warning gets `uc-select warning` on the offending select and the message under the row, linked by `aria-describedby`. Warnings on rows: `unknown_participant`, `unknown_relationship_type`, `self_relationship`, `duplicate_relationship`; `trait_conflict` names both ends. "Add relationship" appends a row and focuses its From select.

**Members** (read-only): derived from the relationship ends — personas with colour avatars, entities as squares, an unknown id in amber mono. An entity with no relationship gives `entity_unrelated`.

Footer: **Delete** (danger text; asks first, `delete_entity` kind `constellation`, warns about use cases that still name it), usage ("Used by 3 use cases"), warning count (amber, `role="status"`), Cancel, primary **Save constellation**. Warnings never block. Flows → `usecases-world`.
